The Wrath of the Chicken Dragon

Connects to: 21.14.

One of the chickens the Spellknight (of the Knights of the Cudgel) has polymorphed into a gold dragon (chicken dragons) has gotten free and is currently wandering about, knocking over trees and clawing mightily at the dirt. It has been growing hungry and somewhat peevish which might pose some problems to anyone who runs into it.
